panels.description: Sitara holds a field tablet over selected physical records while her TJ scans the pages. Frost shakes loose; Nayah watches the exit. Keep upper-left clear for the machinery sound and upper-right clear for Nayah.
The tablet overlays drilling trace and ice-motion plot. A narrow red line shows local acceleration without implying Falcon caused the entire Antarctic crisis. Keep lower area clear.
Meltwater beads along the threshold as Nayah pulls the emergency line taut. Sitara closes the tablet. Leave upper third clear.
The copied record displays the Nexus route and paired-timestamp instruction. Keep the tablet legible and free of clutter.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then the copy has to be complete.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Local acceleration. Not the whole system.
